bundle.shortDescription: Local-first ELF firmware size and symbol analysis for release reviews.
bundle.longDescription: FirmwareSight analyses an ELF firmware artifact on this machine: sections, symbols, memory regions, the size delta between two builds, a five-state release Gate and a portable Release Bundle. Analysis, comparison, Gate and bundling all run offline - there is no network service, no telemetry and no upload.
